registration.note: dose-response measurement only; it may not escalate, replace the incumbent or be reported as a candidate

question_zh: 把训练窗口从 132 个交易日扩到 441 个交易日（2022-01-04..2023-10-31），在 1.32 与 2.64 个有效 epoch 的匹配训练量下，样本外 RankIC 是否随数据量继续上升。
hypothesis: if the low score of every earlier model is a data-quantity failure, the out-of-sample RankIC must rise with the number of training days at matched effective epochs; a flat curve falsifies the data hypothesis at this resolution.

factor.note: the window never reaches the validation split; only the training window start moves

environment_only_changes.note: path-only changes required by the training host: data and cache live on the container-local disk, run artifacts under /mnt/work (network disk that survives a container restart)

budget_only_overrides.model.max_steps: cleared; the registered trajectory steps govern the budget
budget_only_overrides.model.epochs: kept as the upper bound (must exceed the last budget point)
budget_only_overrides.data.splits.train.start: moved earlier to 2023-04-14; the single changed factor
budget_only_overrides.note: any other deviation from the frozen recipe must fail the run guard

budget_points.name: scaling-2.64
budget_points.role: registered second point magnitude (C2 left / C3 right)

exposure.reconcile: samples_seen == steps * batch_size; unique/usable coverage >= min_coverage; realised effective epochs within atol of the declared point

resume.fail_closed: pool, recipe, fitted transforms and sampler batch order must reproduce the checkpoint exactly
resume.note: the two budget points are checkpoints of one uninterrupted trajectory, not two runs

derived_reference.calibration: level-1 measured 1054256 usable samples over 132 trading days, scaled linearly by trading days; the driver re-derives both from the pool actually built

deviation_tolerance.rule: a realised value beyond +/-5% stops the run and reports; the estimate is not edited afterwards

concurrency.sharing: packed by the memory pre-flight, not by a fixed map

evaluation_scope.cloud: validation split 2023-11-01..2023-11-15 = 10 trading days, process diagnostic only
evaluation_scope.formal: the five declared research windows produced locally by replaying exported per-budget-point weights; a cloud validation score is never the delivery evidence
